instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Read the conversations, messages and saved items I pulled from a connected account such as Discord, Slack, Telegram, Signal, Instagram, Messenger, X bookmarks or Pinterest", and give it source.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-what-i-pulled-from-an-account and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give source (discord, slack, telegram, signal, instagram-messages, messenger-messages, x-bookmarks or pinterest-pins) and optionally account (the name it was pulled under, default "default").
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: account-snapshot-part (records:list).
